alternatives_rejected.why: Frontend errors are a downstream symptom, because every worst failing trace ends at recommendationservice (E3) and the only large latency deviations are in recommendationservice (E1).

The socket deviation (z=107) is an order of magnitude smaller than the latency deviation (z=1002, E4). That fits connections staying open longer under delay, not a socket-driven fault, though this is not conclusive.
CPU has the weakest of the top deviations (z=52.54, E4), well below latency and socket, so it is more likely secondary than primary.
They appear in the worst traces (E3), but no metric deviation for them appears in the all-services ranking (E1).

proposed_fix.description: Inspect recommendationservice for injected network latency (for example a tc/netem rule or chaos experiment) and remove it. Then confirm that recommendationservice p50/p90 latency and frontend error rate return to baseline. If they do not, check whether socket/connection pool limits or CPU are the actual fault.
